stages.title: Structure Framing
stages.condition: the steel framing structure is erected and inspected
stages.source: Amit Chawla receives 120000 rupees when the steel framing structure is erected and inspected

stages.title: Roof Finishing
stages.condition: the waterproof roof slab casting is completed and cured
stages.source: Amit Chawla receives 150000 rupees when the waterproof roof slab casting is completed and cured

unclear.question: The stated total is 250000 rupees but the stages sum to 270000 rupees. Which amount is correct?
unclear.source: The stated agreement total is 250000 rupees, with 120000 rupees for structure framing and 150000 rupees for roof finishing.
